description: Frozen offline mirror of the Tier A operational-space Atlas (vestserver ~/runs/campaign/atlas): 150 EFIT states (133 magnetics + 17 electron-kinetic) from 32 shots 39906-43002, labelled good or admissible under statistical_891.
distribution: repository-only (not in the wheel or sdist)

layout.v1/: state and Thomson profile tables (state key contract v1, #1454) + virial identity export
layout.confinement/: Lane D Tier A confinement table (#548), magnetics lineage only (133 rows)
layout.stability/: Lane N stability atlas v2 (#1429/#1509): DCON n=1..6, RDCON/STRIDE n=1,2
layout.snapshot_manifest.json + README.md: capture record of v1/, equilibrium_quality/, confinement/ (snapshot v2, captured 2026-10-14)

verification_and_validation.relocated: 2026-11-06 (#2277), git mv of the whole directory, byte-identical; relative paths inside snapshot_manifest.json unchanged

stability_atlas_v2.relocated: 2026-11-06 (#2277), git mv, byte-identical; the pipeline-improvement snapshot_manifest.json records the same SHA-256 under the original names
stability_atlas_v2.representation: gzip CSV re-serialised by pandas from the server's atlas_n.csv / atlas_surfaces.csv in workflow/pipeline_improvement/make_snapshot.py (2026-10-30); not byte-identical to the server CSV, values unchanged by intent
stability_atlas_v2.reader: pandas.read_csv; vaft.process.mhd_stability.load_stability_atlas expects uncompressed atlas_n.csv/atlas_surfaces.csv in one directory

keys.state: (shot, time_efit_s, efit_lineage); join on round(time_efit_s * 1e6) microseconds
keys.lineage_labels: v1/ and confinement/ use 'magnetics' / 'electron_kinetic'; stability/ uses 'magnetics-only' / 'electron-kinetic' for the same states

grain.stability/atlas_surfaces.csv.gz: state x n_tor x solver x m (6970)

vaft/data/confinement/vest_tier_a_confin.relationship: compact derived representation of confinement/table.csv for vaft.data.public.load_vest_tier_a_confinement: same 133 rows in the same order, 57 of the 68 columns (drops the 11 descriptor columns n_e_definition, p_loss_definition, w_th_definition, tau_e_definition, b_t_definition, m_eff_source, source_database, source_release, source_reference, efit_product_sha256, assumptions); numeric values agree within rtol 5e-6 (rounded); 'accepted' equals 'selected'
vaft/data/confinement/vest_tier_a_confin.kept_separately_because: it is a wheel-independent runtime input of vaft.data.public with its own manifest (vaft/data/confinement/manifest.json)
